blocks.task_summary: Find the composite function (f composed with g)(x) = 2tan x - tan^3 x by substituting g into f.
method_path: Substitute g(x) = tan x into f(x) = 2x - x^3
Write (f composed with g)(x) = 2tan x - tan^3 x

evidence.basis: attempt to substitute g into f (M1); f composed with g of x = 2tan x - tan^3 x (A1)

blocks.task_summary: Sketch the graph of y = 2tan x - tan^3 x for -1 <= x <= 1, labeling local maximum at approximately (0.685, 1.09) and local minimum at approximately (-0.685, -1.09).
method_path: Sketch odd function curve passing through origin with a maximum above y = 1 and a minimum below y = -1
Plot endpoints at x = +/-1 with y in [0.6, 0.8] and [-0.8, -0.6] respectively
Label local maximum at (0.685, 1.09) and local minimum at (-0.685, -1.09)

evidence.basis: A1 for approximately correct odd function passing through origin with max above y=1 and min below y=-1; A1 for endpoints at x=+/-1 and y in [0.6,0.8] and [-0.8,-0.6]; A1 for maximum at (0.685,1.09) and minimum at (-0.685,-1.09)
